senses.gloss:
ह्रग् ह्रग् (also written ह्लग्), cl. 1. P.
ह्रगति, जह्राग, अह्रगीत्, &c., to cover,
hide, conceal: Caus. ह्रगयति, &c.

ह्रणिया ह्रणिया, f. (= हृणीया at p. 1175,
col. 3), censure, reproach, shame, bashfulness.

ह्रद् ह्रद्, an older form of rt. ह्राद्,
q. v.

ह्राद् ह्राद् (closely connected with rt.
ह्लाद्; cf. rt. ह्रद्), cl. 1. A. ह्रादते,
जह्रादे, ह्रादितुम्, to sound (as a drum or other
musical instrument); to roar (as water, thunder);
[cf. Zend zrād; Gr. χλάζω, κέ-χλαδα, probably
χάλαζα; Lat. grando, grandinat; Goth. grêtan;
Angl. Sax. grœtan.]

ह्रद, अस्, m. a large or deep piece of water, a
lake, pool; a ray of light.
—ह्रद-ग्रह, अस्, m.
‘lake-monster,’ a crocodile, alligator.
—ह्रदान्तर
(˚द-अन्˚), अम्, n. another lake.

ह्राद, अस्, m. noise, sound; N. of a son of
Hiraṇya-kaśipu.

ह्रदिनी, f. a river (either as supplying or issuing
from a lake); lightning [cf. ह्रादिनी].

ह्रप् ह्रप् (= rt. ह्लप्, q. v.), cl. 10. P. ह्रा-
पयति, &c., to speak; to sound, creak.

ह्रस् ह्रस् [cf. rts. रस्, ह्लस्], cl. 1. P. ह्र-
सति (ep. also A. -ते), जह्रास, ह्रसितुम्,
to sound (in this sense = rt. ह्लस्), to become small,
be diminished or lessened: Caus. ह्रासयति, -यितुम्,
Aor. अजिह्रसत्, to make small or less, shorten,
[]
lessen, decrease, diminish: Desid. जिह्रसिषति:
Intens. जाह्रस्यते, जाह्रस्ति.

ह्रसित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded; made little, short-
ened, curtailed, diminished.
ह्रसिमन्, आ, m. smallness, shortness.

ह्रसिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. fr. ह्रस्व), short-
est, smallest; very short or small.

ह्रसीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. fr. ह्रस्व),
shorter, smaller; very small or short; (असी), f. a
variety of the Gāyatrī metre (containing two lines of
six syllables and one line of seven).

ह्रस्व, अस्, आ, अम्, short, small, little, short in
stature, dwarfish; low (as a doorway &c.); prosodi-
ally or metrically short (opposed to दीर्घ; cf.
लघु); (अस्), m. a dwarf; a short vowel, a vowel
containing only one Mātrā; (आ), f. a female dwarf;
a sort of kidney-bean (= मुद्ग-पर्णी); other
plants or trees, = नाग-बला; = भूमि-जम्बू;
(अम्), n. a particular short measure; a kind of
vegetable (= गौर-सुवर्ण); green or black sul-
phate of iron; [cf. Gr. χέρηϊ, χερείων, χείρων,
χείριστος; perhaps Lat. brevis.]
—ह्रस्व-कुश,
अस्, m. short Kuśa grass, white Kuśa grass.
—ह्रस्व-
गर्भ, अस्, m. Kuśa grass.
—ह्रस्व-गवेधुका,
f. the plant Uraria Lagopodioides.
—ह्रस्व-जम्बु,
उस्, m. the small Jambu tree.
—ह्रस्व-तण्डुल,
अस्, m. a kind of rice (= राजान्न).
—ह्रस्व-ता, f.
or ह्रस्व-त्व, अम्, n. shortness.
—ह्रस्व-दर्भ,
अस्, m. short Kuśa grass, white Kuśa grass.
—ह्रस्व-
दा, f. gum olibanum (= शल्लकी).
—ह्रस्व-पत्-
त्रक, अस्, m. ‘having short leaves,’ a sort of
mountain Madhūka or Bassia; (इका), f. a particular
plant or tree (= अश्वत्थी).
—ह्रस्व-पूर्व, अस्, आ,
अम्, preceded by a short vowel.
—ह्रस्व-प्लक्ष,
a species of small Plaksha tree (= पुण्ड्र).
—ह्रस्व-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, having small fruit or
kernels; (आ), f. the tree Bhūmi-jambū.
—ह्रस्व-
बाहुक, अस्, आ, अम्, short-armed.
—ह्रस्व-मूर्ति,
इस्, इस्, इ, short in stature, small in figure, dwarfish.
—ह्रस्व-मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a small root;
(अस्), m. the red sugar-cane.
—ह्रस्व-रोमन्, आ,
m. ‘having short hair,’ N. of a king.
—ह्रस्व-
शाखाशिफ, अस्, m. ‘having short branch-roots,’ a
small tree, shrub.
—ह्रस्व-सभा, f. a small or
narrow hall.
—ह्रस्वाग्नि (˚व-अग्˚), इस्, m. the
gigantic swallow-wort (= अर्क).
—ह्रस्वाङ्ग (˚व-
अङ्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, short-bodied, dwarfish; (अस्), m. a
dwarf; the medicinal plant and root called Jīvaka,
q. v.
—ह्रस्वोदय (˚व-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, followed
by a short vowel.
—ह्रस्वोपध (˚व-उप्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, having a short penultimate; preceded by a short
vowel.
ह्रस्वक, अस्, आ, अम्, short, small, &c. = ह्रस्व.

ह्रास, अस्, m. sound, noise; shortening, diminu-
tion, abatement, decrease, decline, deterioration, de-
triment; paucity, scarcity.
ह्रास ह्रास. See above.

ह्रासक, अस्, इका, अम्, shortening, diminishing,
decreasing.

ह्रादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sounding, making a sound or
noise; (इनी), f. Indra's thunderbolt; lightning;
a river [cf. ह्रदिनी]; the gum olibanum tree (=
शल्लकी).

ह्रादुनि, (in Ṛg-veda I. 32, 13) a weapon, the
weapon of Vṛtra, a thunderbolt, (Sāy. = अशनि.)
—ह्रादुनी-वृत् or ह्रादुनि-वृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. wield-
ing the thunderbolt, (said of the Maruts; Sāy. ex-
plains ह्रादुनी-वृतः by ह्रादुन्या अशनेः प्र-
वर्तकाः, Ṛg-veda V. 54, 3.)
